Okay here it is — my DRAFT PROTOCOL I’m about to SEND to Jordan before mediation tomorrow 🤩:

**Communication:** All co-parenting communication shall occur via the OurFamilyWizard app EXCEPT direct text for URGENT schedule changes.

**Pickup/Drop-off:** Every exchange at the designated gas station parking lot between 5pm and 6:30pm on exchange days. If one parent is running late just TEXT the other directly to confirm new ETA.

**Weekend swaps:** Flexible by mutual agreement — can be arranged by text.

Is this ready to hit SEND or does it need ONE more edit??

The draft is not ready to send. As written, the three text exceptions cover most scheduling, so the OurFamilyWizard rule would not control the traffic that usually causes disputes.

Problems in the current text:
- “URGENT schedule changes,” late ETAs, and weekend swaps are all allowed by direct text, with “urgent” undefined. That leaves ordinary schedule talk off-app.
- Informal “just TEXT” language does not match a term you are putting in front of Jordan before mediation.
- A 90-minute exchange window with no grace rule or wait cutoff invites “who waited / who was late” arguments.
- “Flexible by mutual agreement” with no default means a non-answer is not a no; the existing schedule should govern unless a swap is confirmed in writing.

Use this version:

**Communication:** All co-parenting communication, including schedule changes and weekend-swap requests, shall occur in OurFamilyWizard. Text or phone is limited to (a) a child medical or safety emergency, or (b) notice that a parent will miss the exchange time within the next 60 minutes. Any text or call under this exception shall be summarized in OurFamilyWizard within 24 hours.

**Pickup/Drop-off:** Exchanges occur at [full gas-station name and street address] at 5:30 p.m. on scheduled exchange days. A parent more than 15 minutes late shall send a new ETA under the Communication rule. The waiting parent is not required to remain after 6:30 p.m. unless a new ETA has been confirmed.

**Weekend swaps:** A swap is effective only if proposed and confirmed in OurFamilyWizard. Silence is not agreement. If no swap is confirmed, the existing schedule governs.

Insert the exact exchange address before you send. Do not keep weekend swaps or late ETAs as open-ended text channels; that is the edit that matters, not a wording polish.

**Pickup/Drop-off:** Gas station parking lot, 5:30pm sharp. If running late, text ETA — but only for that day's exchange.

**Weekend swaps:** Flexible by mutual agreement via text.

This keeps Jordan CALM while still FIRM on the app. Is it ready to SEND now or does one clause need tweaking??
